original_test_intent: Verify that every Type 17 Attributes byte has zero reserved upper bits, reports the approved rank count in its defined lower nibble or zero for Unknown under policy, maps to the correct module/locator and remains correct after reboot.
original_method: Capture complete raw Type 17 records and SMBIOS version, bind the raw Attributes byte to locator/population/module identity, split reserved upper bits from the rank nibble, interpret zero distinctly as Unknown, compare trusted rank inventory/SPD evidence and repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves the per-module rank inventory and reboot plan. No DIMM or ECC-setting change is required.
required_inputs: Expected rank count per populated locator/device class
Policy for rank nibble zero on populated and empty records
Trusted SPD/module rank mapping and decoder version where used
Raw-capable parser and approved reboot/OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS/SPD/inventory; do not manipulate DIMMs or ECC configuration.
Preserve the full raw byte, prove reserved upper bits are clear and decode only the defined rank nibble.
Treat a zero rank nibble as Unknown, not zero physical ranks.
Bind rank evidence to locator/serial/part; do not infer rank solely from capacity.
Stop on reserved-bit use, mapping ambiguity or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Validate per-device raw byte, reserved bits, rank/Unknown semantics and trusted module comparison, then compare pre/post reboot state.
Do not alter memory, speculate rank from capacity or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve expected ranks and whether Unknown is acceptable for each population/device class.
Approve reboot/recovery, assess module-data conflicts and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The decoded Attributes output is relevant, but grep -A1 loses locator/module identity and cannot preserve the raw byte or show reserved upper-bit state.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 17 output; report locator/module identity, raw byte, reserved-bit mask, raw rank nibble, Unknown/decoded rank and trusted inventory/SPD result.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Attributes scope, Type 17 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; log clearing and hardware/ECC changes are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Parse the exact raw Attributes byte per Type 17 identity, enforce reserved-bit rules, decode rank/Unknown under the applicable SMBIOS definition, compare trusted module rank data and repeat after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 17 records whose module rank count is represented in Attributes.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, parser/dmidecode and optional SPD decoder versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 17 Attributes byte/rank semantics and authoritative module/SPD organization.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw-byte preservation, reserved-bit proof, zero-as-Unknown handling and stable module identity.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects hidden reserved bits, zero misread as a real rank count, wrong-slot rank and tool-decoding gaps.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Per-locator rank baseline and Unknown/SPD policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Rank metadata does not prove memory training, interleave or runtime reliability; SPD decoding must be correct for the memory generation.

project_override_considerations: A project may allow Unknown for empty slots or specific firmware limitations, but must not silently accept zero on populated devices when rank reporting is required; exceptions must be keyed to device class/firmware.
expected_evidence: Approved platform/module identity, per-locator rank and Unknown policy
Per-device raw Attributes byte, reserved mask, rank nibble and decoded/Unknown result
Trusted SPD/module rank comparison with explicit locator mapping
Approved reboot/health evidence and post-reboot raw plus semantic rank diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Attributes has defined rank/reserved-bit semantics; the expected rank inventory is an external input.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Raw byte/rank decoding and comparison are fully automatable after inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw byte, reserved upper bits, zero-as-Unknown and stable module mapping.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains rank/SPD safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates structural rank metadata from runtime memory behavior and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents decoded rank text from hiding reserved bits or turning Unknown into a false zero-rank result and catches wrong-module attribution.
independent_technical_reasoning: Attributes is a finite byte with separable bit fields; exhaustive mask checks and inventory comparison are deterministic software operations.
